intro.title: Admetec Lights
intro.description: Loupes and lights are two elements that make up a single solution and should be considered together, not as separate products. Matching the best light to your loupes is a key step in the customization process.
features: Anti-curing yellow filter (built-in or external, depending on model)
Tailored lights for enhanced vision at different magnifications

buyingGuide.title: How to choose the right headlight
buyingGuide.text: Four key factors: (1) Wired or cordless operation, (2) Weight, (3) Light intensity (LUX), (4) Compatibility with your loupes magnification. Cordless headlights offer the most convenience and freedom of movement; wired headlights offer lower weight on the loupes and very long run time. Higher magnification needs a stronger and narrower light beam.

categories.name: Wireless
categories.tagline: Butterfly™ EVO is Admetec's cordless headlight series with two models designed for optimal efficiency.

products.name: Butterfly EVO
products.description: Butterfly™ EVO combines effective lighting in an ultra-lightweight, easy-to-use, wireless configuration. Ideal for everyday clinical work at low-to-medium magnifications.

products.name: Butterfly-S EVO
products.description: Butterfly-S™ EVO provides stronger light intensity to enable work with higher magnifications.

products.name: Butterfly EVO Extender
products.description: Shifts the battery from the loupes mount to a remote clip-on socket, reducing weight on the nose bridge for improved comfort and extreme lightweight.
features: Accessory for Butterfly™ EVO and Butterfly-S™ EVO

benefits.title: Cordless
benefits.text: Freedom of movement increases comfort and efficiency.

benefits.title: Lightweight

categories.name: Wired
categories.tagline: Orchid™ is Admetec's wired headlight series featuring four models. Each delivers optimal illumination for your specific needs.

products.name: Orchid Headlight
products.description: The original Orchid™ generates a focused, uniform and shadow-free round beam for bright white illumination.

products.name: Orchid-F Headlight
products.description: Orchid-F™ features an integrated yellow filter that prevents composite hardening during restorative work. The filter can be switched on and off as needed.

products.name: Orchid-E Headlight
products.description: Orchid-E™ is designed for a high-intensity, narrow light beam. Particularly well suited for high magnifications.

products.name: Orchid-S Headlight
products.description: Orchid-S™ provides a higher-intensity light, ideal for surgical procedures.

benefits.title: Lightweight
benefits.text: Loupes-mounted headlight and battery pack are streamlined for minimal weight, supporting comfortable all-day use.

benefits.title: Ergonomic configuration

benefits.title: Plug and play
benefits.text: Every model includes two batteries; switching between depleted and charged is quick and easy.

benefits.title: Compatible
benefits.text: Can be mounted on most loupes models.
